The ruins of AtlantaLas ruinas de Atlanta

The destroyed railroad roundhouse, Atlanta — photograph by George N. Barnard, 1864, public domain (Library of Congress).La rotonda ferroviaria destruida, Atlanta — fotografía de George N. Barnard, 1864, dominio público (Library of Congress).
Source · Lincoln, before Atlanta fell · August 23, 1864Fuente · Lincoln, antes de que cayera Atlanta · 23 de agosto de 1864

A president who expected to loseUn presidente que esperaba perder

“This morning, as for some days past, it seems exceedingly probable that this Administration will not be re-elected. Then it will be my duty to so co-operate with the President elect, as to save the Union between the election and the inauguration.”“Esta mañana, como en los últimos días, parece sumamente probable que esta Administración no sea reelegida. Entonces será mi deber cooperar con el presidente electo de tal modo que se salve la Unión entre la elección y la toma de posesión.” — Abraham Lincoln, “blind memorandum,” August 1864. Public domain.— Abraham Lincoln, “memorando a ciegas,” agosto de 1864. Dominio público.
